annotations.title: Write an ingredient line from fields

description: Turn structured fields (amount, unit, item, prep, notes) into a natural recipe line ("1½ cups flour, sifted"), with plurals, fractions and US/metric units. More APIs from FitzTopPicks: https://fitztoppicks.com/apis?utm_source=mcp-api&utm_medium=mcp&utm_campaign=more-apis

amount.description: The amount: 1.5, "1 1/2", "1½" (leave out for "salt, to taste").

amountMax.description: The top of a range (2-3: amount=2, amountMax=3).

notes.description: Anything else, after a comma: "plus more to serve".

prepPosition.description: auto (default), before or after the item.

spelling.description: us (default: liters) or uk (litres) for long metric names.

unit.description: The unit in any spelling /parse knows: cup, cups, tbsp, tablespoon, g, clove, can, large... (leave out for counted items).

name: write_ingredient_line
title: Write an ingredient line from fields
